# Spectator Visibility

Source: [4834](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4834); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4834-n1"></a>
